answer: An agent registers by locking a thirty-epoch vesting deposit as a slashable bond, putting its own money behind the name. An agent caught signing two conflicting attestations in one epoch faces proof via comparing signatures on the ledger. Once the fault is proven, half the bond is cut and the remainder frozen for ten epochs. No identity exists without its own karst of locked funds. A copper deposit cannot split across identities. Each fable stake is slashable the moment its owner cheats.
